report_discrepancies.note: General Fund budget schedule: State sources lines add to 9,593,522 but the printed Total state sources is 9,684,128 (which agrees with the statements p3 and p6). One printed state line appears misstated; all lines recorded as printed.

notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental statement lines are the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p3-4); Total column nets transfers to zero (transfers_in/out computed from the fund columns). 'Support services - student' split by fund column into General Fund support services (1,982,907) and Activities/Student Fee fund spending (572,775, categorized as student activities). Carline tax and public power district sales tax categorized as other taxes; homestead exemption and property tax credit as state aid. Balance sheet taken from the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2, Total Governmental Activities column); no liabilities (cash basis). Component unit (School District 46 Educational Foundation) excluded. Detail: General Fund uses the budget-and-actual schedule (p9-12), which is more detailed than the General Fund components page (p6) and the fund-level statements; no object (salary/benefit) breakdown is printed so expenditure detail is 'not itemized', and the budget column is shown only at function-group level for most lines. The budget schedule counts 300,000 of General Fund spending that is actually transfers to the Depreciation (200,000) and Employee Benefit (100,000) funds (reclassification column on p6; matching transfers in on p13-14); recorded as contra lines (Instruction -175,000, Operation and maintenance -75,000, Student transportation -50,000) plus an other financing line, so instruction category totals 12,624,725 + 85,253 + 385,135 - 175,000 = 12,920,113 as in the statement. State programs and Federal programs lines categorized as instruction as the statement counts them there. Zero-actual General Fund lines (1990 Other local receipts, 5150 Tax anticipation notes, 5000 Debt services) omitted. Leasing Corporation fund (receipts 50,635, disbursements 15, transfer out 1,090,912) has no budget schedule, only statement data; the nonmajor combining schedule (p7-8) is not recorded in detail because each nonmajor fund has its own schedule. In the Special Building schedule the line labelled Public power district sales tax (504,848) and Other local receipts (85,214) do not match the statement classification (p3 shows 85,214 as public power district sales tax and puts the remainder in state receipts); recorded as printed with review. Read pages 1-23 of 23
